archetypes.name: checks-port
archetypes.rationale: Relevant-checks orchestration moved from shell to Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python checks dispatcher against the retired shell behavior described in the plan. Focus on changed-file discovery, direct target routing, failure envelopes, redaction, and skip semantics. Pay special attention to environment scrubbing and log path validation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ship-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Step 8+ now has one Python ship path and many prompt docs changed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 8 ship wrapper, ship exit matrix, and implement skill prose as an integrated state machine. Check that removed shell-driver branches did not leave contradictory resume, conflict, OOS, or finalization instructions behind. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
